zendesk_realtime_mvp: Batch CSV export is enough for MVP. Real-time Zendesk integration is post-MVP.
auto_send_replies: Yes. All replies are drafts. No message is sent to a customer without a human approving it first.
language_support_mvp: English and Polish only. German is post-MVP.
urgency_rules: Urgency is high if the ticket mentions service outage, data loss, or the word 'urgent'. Otherwise normal.
analytics_dashboard_mvp: Simple CSV export and a summary table are enough for MVP.
default: Use the conservative option and expand after the pilot.
